name: go2rtc-tizen
description: Samsung Tizen TV viewer for go2rtc cameras

scripts.package: npm run build && tizen package -t wgt -s ${TIZEN_PROFILE:-default} -- dist
scripts.wgt: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../go2rtc-tizen.wgt && zip -qr -X ../go2rtc-tizen.wgt . && cd .. && unzip -l go2rtc-tizen.wgt
